name: Chenab Valley Forest Fire & Landslide Risk

detections.evidence: Severe loss of NIR reflectance combined with elevated SWIR thermal emission index across steep slopes.
Burned canopy situated on >35° slope gradients above major transport artery and riverbed.

authority_alert: HIGH HAZARD ALERT: Post-Wildfire Burn Scar and Severe Slope Destabilization detected across Chenab Valley (33.1463°N, 75.5412°E). 19.3% of catchment shows destroyed vegetative anchor. In case of forecasted monsoon rainfall, probability of debris flows and highway obstruction is CRITICAL.

exposure.note: Down-slope settlements and National Highway 244 corridor located directly beneath the unstable drainage gully.

limitations: Steep topography and terrain relief shadows may mask acute flame fronts on northern slope faces.
Post-burn ash spectral profile shares signatures with bare dark slate rock; verified with baseline NDVI diff.
